findings.quote: 1.1.6 "Information" or "Confidential Information" means all information of whatsoever nature and in whatever form or medium (whether oral, written, electronic, pictorial, magnetic, digital or machine-readable) disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party, whether before, on or after the date hereof, relating to the business, affairs, products, software, source code, object code, system architectures, trade secrets, pricing policies, financial projections, reseller matrices, customer accounts or operations of the Disclosing Party or its Affiliates, which is marked as proprietary or confidential or which by its very nature ought reasonably to be understood by a prudent commercial person to be confidential, together with all analyses, compilations, extracts, notes, memoranda and other records prepared by the Receiving Party containing or reflecting such information;
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred (0.52) against PB02 Definition of Confidential Information. Borderline: breach or unclear 0.46, so this must be reviewed by a lawyer.

findings.quote: 2.2 The Receiving Party shall forthwith notify the Disclosing Party in writing upon discovering or suspecting any unauthorised use, disclosure, dissemination or loss of any Confidential Information, and shall, at its own expense, co-operate fully with the Disclosing Party in taking all reasonable steps to recover the information and mitigate the effects thereof.
findings.why: Substantive term that no playbook rule covers (Jev other_term 0.96).

findings.quote:
3.1 The Receiving Party shall be entitled to disclose the Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party only to such of its Representatives and Affiliates who have a clear and demonstrable need to know the same strictly for the discharge of the Permitted Purpose, provided always that:
3.1.1 the Receiving Party shall, anterior to any such disclosure, fully apprise each such Representative and Affiliate of the strictly confidential character of the Information;
3.1.2 each such Representative and Affiliate is subject to binding confidentiality undertakings or professional obligations of secrecy no less restrictive than those embodied in this Agreement; and
3.1.3 the Receiving Party shall remain primarily liable and fully responsible to the Disclosing Party for any breach of the terms of this Agreement committed by any such Representative or Affiliate as if such breach had been committed by the Receiving Party itself.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred (0.69) against PB05 Permitted disclosure to Representatives and Group.
Jev reads the clause as matches preferred (0.78) against PB04 Carve-outs.

findings.quote:
5.1 If the Receiving Party or any of its Representatives is required to disclose any Confidential Information by operation of Applicable Law, valid subpoena, court order or any formal demand of a competent regulatory or supervisory authority, the Receiving Party may disclose such Information strictly to the extent required, provided that, to the extent legally permissible, it shall:
5.1.1 give prompt written notice thereof to the Disclosing Party so that the Disclosing Party may seek a protective order, injunction or other appropriate remedy;
5.1.2 consult with the Disclosing Party and render all reasonable assistance, at the Disclosing Party's sole expense, in opposing or restricting the scope of such disclosure; and
5.1.3 in the event that disclosure is unavoidable, furnish only that portion of the Confidential Information which is legally mandated, and use all reasonable endeavours to obtain reliable assurance that confidential treatment will be accorded to the Information so disclosed.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred (0.90) against PB06 Compelled disclosure.

findings.quote:
6.1 Subject to Clause 6.2, upon the written demand of the Disclosing Party at any time, or forthwith upon the termination or expiry of this Agreement, the Receiving Party shall:
6.1.1 securely deliver up to the Disclosing Party or, at the Disclosing Party's written direction, permanently delete and destroy all documents, media, software, files and materials containing, embodying or derived from the Confidential Information then in its possession, custody or control; and
6.1.2 provide to the Disclosing Party, within fourteen (14) days of such demand, a formal certificate signed by a duly authorised officer confirming full compliance with the provisions of this Clause 6.1.
findings.fallback_cited: Any period of 5 Business Days or more. (ASSUMED)
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback (0.56) against PB07 Return and destruction.

findings.quote: 6.2 Notwithstanding the provisions of Clause 6.1, the Receiving Party shall be entitled to retain one (1) copy of the Confidential Information to the extent strictly necessary for compliance with mandatory legal, regulatory or professional record-keeping obligations, and shall not be obliged to expunge copies created in the ordinary course of business pursuant to routine, automated electronic archival and disaster-recovery backup procedures, provided that any Information so retained shall remain subject to the confidentiality and non-use covenants herein contained for so long as it is retained.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred (0.50) against PB07 Return and destruction. Borderline: breach or unclear 0.42, so this must be reviewed by a lawyer.
